footer: Events reported 19–22 November 2026 · Compiled from wire reports

lead.headline: COP31 talks collapse as fossil-fuel row sinks deal
lead.summary: The UN climate summit in Antalya ends in failure after a final draft omits any mention of fossil fuels. The EU, island nations and Norway reject the text; the summit becomes the longest COP in history and the first major breakdown since 2009.

stories.headline: Two wounded as Iran strikes Bahrain again
stories.summary: Bahrain says an Iranian attack on a civilian industrial site wounds two, while Tehran claims it hit two US Patriot radars. Iran also strikes tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Factory fire kills 3, dozens missing
stories.summary: A blaze tears through a candy factory in Cikande, killing three workers. Rescuers search the ruins for 36 people still unaccounted for.

stories.headline: Russian drone collapses Kyiv building
stories.summary: A drone strike brings down an apartment block near the capital, killing three and leaving at least 14 people feared trapped under the rubble.

stories.headline: World Court: Myanmar committed genocide
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice rules 9-6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017, the first time a state has been found responsible. It orders reparations.
